title: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warns Americans of 'bumps in the road' after tech outages
summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton has issued a warning to Americans regarding potential disruptions in travel due to recent technology outages. These outages have affected various sectors, including air travel, Microsoft 365 services, and banking transactions, raising concerns ahead of the busy Thanksgiving period. Clayton's remarks highlight the importance of preparedness as travelers navigate these unforeseen challenges during one of the year's peak travel times.
